notes:
Summary: Nucleus Code Insights builds an internal developer search + code review assistant used by engineering and platform teams. Primary ask: reliable embeddings + reranking pipeline that can handle large-scale code corpora with frequent re-indexing and strict SSO/compliance requirements.

Key requirements (from AE/SE convo 2024-10-21):
- Corpus: ~220M distinct code artifacts (repos + blobs), ~40TB raw; target vector dimension ~1024 for dense models.
- Indexing cadence: hourly incremental updates, nightly differential snapshots, weekly full reindex (customer also asks 'can we do daily full for critical repos?').
- Query profile: mixed read/write; typical QPS target 150-250, spikes to 800 during release windows.
- Latency SLOs: P50 < 80ms, P95 < 300ms end-to-end (embedding + ANN + reranker). Tail latency hard constraint: "can't accept >5s" per product PM.
- Cost sensitivity: looking to keep cost per query (embeddings + reranking) under $0.02 on average; strong interest in quantized/4-bit model variants and packing/batching recommendations.
- Reranking: cross-encoder reranker for top-50 HNSW candidates; model will be fine-tuned on pairwise ranking dataset (internal). Aim: reranker to improve MRR by 12-18% vs BM25 baseline.
- Routing/fallback: prefer regional routing (NA primary, EU failover) with a lightweight fallback to a smaller open model when Dedicated capacity exhausted.

Security/compliance notes:
- Must support SSO / SAML with SCIM provisioning; infosec requires SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence and customer-managed KMS for private deployments.
- Data residency: logs and source-code vectors for EU projects must remain in eu-central-1.
- Auditability: need request-level audit logs retained for 12 months for security team.

POC history / timeline:
- 2024-08-15: Intro call (AE Samira) — initial discovery, corpus sizing estimate.
- 2024-09-10: Deep-technical sync (SE Diego) — walked through current ANN topology (HNSW) and reranker dataset; customer shared example pipeline. Linked FF transcript.
- 2024-10-21: Pricing + architecture review (AE + SE + Infra) — agreed on POC scope: 2-week benchmark on Redwood Dedicated nodes with hybrid quantized models; focus on latency & cost per q.
- 2024-10-28: Security kickoff — customer provided initial SAML metadata but staging cert missing. Legal flagged residency clause.
- 2024-11-03: Pre-POC readiness call — validated dataset export, agreed to run 100M subset test on Dedicated.

Technical questions open / POC success criteria:
- Validate ANN recall at 100M vs 220M at target latency budgets (p50/p95).
- Demonstrate reranker throughput: cross-encoder rerank top-50 at 200 QPS while keeping p95 < 300ms.
- Show cost model for hourly incremental reindexes (compute + I/O) and estimate per-query charge under committed capacity.
- Confirm SAML SCIM provisioning flow to staging environment and provide SAML metadata.

Customer quotes / color:
- "We can tolerate small precision loss if it means cutting cost by 40% at scale." — Senior Eng Manager
- "Tail latency kills adoption for engineers; search must feel instant during pushes." — Product PM
